item.title: Former El Monte students allege sex abuse by employees; Some cases going back to 1990s
item.description: Former students in the El Monte Union High School District allege sexual abuse by employees and are part of a civil lawsuit involving cases dating back to the early 1990s.

item.title: Deadly LaGuardia runway crash raises concerns over aviation safety, controller shortage
item.description: A deadly runway collision at LaGuardia Airport is raising renewed concerns about aviation safety and the nationwide shortage of air traffic controllers.

item.title: LA homeless crisis: City vows to address people living in underground storm drains
item.description: A disturbing discovery in South Los Angeles revealed people living inside storm drains amid unsafe and unsanitary conditions.

item.title: Jury deadlocked in landmark Meta, Youtube social media addiction trial
item.description: A Los Angeles judge warns of a partial retrial as jurors struggle to reach a verdict in the landmark addiction lawsuit against Meta and YouTube.

item.title: Over 100 LA shelter dogs flown to Chicago for adoption to escape euthanasia
item.description: Nearly 100 Los Angeles shelter dogs were flown to Chicago for adoption to create space for over 300 animals seized in a Lake Hughes animal cruelty and hoarding investigation.

item.title: LA leaders to vote on stripping César Chávez’s name amid abuse allegations
item.description: Los Angeles officials are considering motions to rename holidays and schools honoring César Chávez following sexual abuse allegations from Dolores Huerta and others.

item.title: Thai artist Jeff Satur expands his universe beyond ‘Red Giant’
item.description: Thai superstar Jeff Satur is continuing to expand his global presence — and during a recent stop in Los Angeles, he shared more about the stories behind his music and upcoming projects.

item.title: $50,000 reward offered as Riverside donkey killings reach 'horrific' new peak
item.description: Riverside County residents are calling for a task force to investigate the killing and mutilation of 21 donkeys amid a $50,000 reward for information.

item.title: Dodger fans face record-breaking ticket prices for Opening Day 2026
item.description: Dodger fans are paying record prices for the 2026 MLB Opening Day.

item.title: Orphaned Monrovia bear cubs moved to San Diego wildlife center after mother euthanized
item.description: Two orphaned black bear cubs from Monrovia are receiving specialized rehabilitation at San Diego Humane Society’s Ramona Wildlife Center to prepare for a return to the wild.
